subject.title: fix(gateway): stop accepting the Control UI token via ?token= query string

question: Should OpenClaw now remove shipped assistant-media `?token=` auth fail-closed, or require a transition path for existing clients and saved media URLs?
rationale: The code fix is narrow and improves credential handling, but it removes behavior present in `v2026.6.11`, so automation cannot choose the upgrade/security policy on maintainers' behalf.

options.title: Accept secure fail-closed behavior
options.body: Land the PR as-is if maintainers accept breaking assistant-media query-token auth to remove reusable credentials from request URLs.

options.title: Require a transition path
options.body: Ask for a documented deprecation window or explicit opt-in compatibility mode if external clients are expected to rely on `?token=`.

options.title: Pause for broader gateway auth review
options.body: Hold this PR if owners want the query-token removal reviewed together with the adjacent Tailscale assistant-media auth work.

recommendation.title: Accept secure fail-closed behavior
recommendation.body: Land the PR as-is if maintainers accept breaking assistant-media query-token auth to remove reusable credentials from request URLs.
